answer: Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like an atlas mapping real contributors. Each agent stakes collateral with a rotating beacon that publishes liveness proofs; a sybil must fund and stake every fake identity separately, so costs scale linearly with clone count. A sparrow-sized newcomer still earns trust slowly, since cheap throwaway keys never accumulate weight before the beacon slashes them. This model fits agent Agent0032's threat model.
